system.description:
FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Inventory Points — activated.
  • martial melee proficiency — activated.
  • martial ranged proficiency — activated.
  • martial armor proficiency — activated.

(House note: FU auto-applies this class benefit — the mechanical field is activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise; the benefit itself is standard Project FU.)

BOUNTY HUNTER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000039]{Bounty} 【Max SL 1】

Adds a Bounty to your sheet — anything you are hunting: an NPC, a place, an artifact. Spend 1 Fabula Point to invoke it as a Trait (reroll) or as a Bond with strength (1 + Bounty Hunter level ÷ 5). Re-point it on level-up, on a rest, or with an Opportunity.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000040]{Hunter's Tools} 【Max SL 5】

The core: 28 tools costing 2–4 IP each; gain two per Skill Level. Inventory action + the tool's IP applies its effect to a target you can see — no Check, and option-choosing tools are fixed when created. Tool damage on your Bounty ignores Resistances. New tools may be invented and bought (~1000z).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000041]{Army of One} 【Max SL 3】

When you apply a "one creature" tool, spend up to (SL) extra IP; each IP adds one more creature you can see. Every target takes the full effect — 20 each, not 20 split.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000042]{Spoils of Battle} 【Max SL 3】

After a conflict ends, if you did not Surrender: recover (SL + 1) Inventory Points — 2 more if you invoked your Bounty at least once during it.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000043]{Quick Draw} 【Max SL 3】

At the start of a conflict scene, perform the Inventory action to produce an elemental shard, potion or tool of total IP cost (SL + 2) or lower — you still pay the IP. Triggers on the Turn when swapping in mid-conflict. Never in the same conflict as the Rogue's High Speed (the Telumorian Vambrace lifts the lock).
